forks.question: If On Air dies after saving a restart request but before the caller reports whether capture started, should that uncertain restart use one of the recording's allowed restarts?

options.says: Count the saved restart request, so a crash before its reply still uses a restart slot.

model.name: recording sessions

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The session starts in its initial state and changes only through the modeled steps.

statements.name: OneRecording
statements.says: At most one recording is running, including while capture is starting, stopping, or waiting to resume.

statements.name: RecordingRetained
statements.says: Every accepted recording remains in the saved record until it has ended and its end has actually been shown.

statements.name: StopRemembered
statements.says: Every Stop received for a running recording is saved until that recording ends, including during startup and across a crash.

statements.name: NoRestartAfterStop
statements.says: Once a Stop is saved, no further request to start capture is made for that recording.

statements.name: FinishAfterCapture
statements.says: Finishing is requested only after capture has ended for good and can no longer write pieces.

statements.name: FinishInOrder
statements.says: Only one recording is being finished at a time, in the order capture ended for good, including after a crash.

statements.name: ExactlyOneEnd
statements.says: Each recording ends at most once, with a single permanent outcome of handed over or kept.

statements.name: OutcomeMatchesFinish
statements.says: The saved end notice contains the outcome and error reported by finishing, and the pieces location when the recording is kept.

statements.name: EndShownCorrectly
statements.says: Every end notice reports its saved outcome and finishing error, and a kept recording's notice includes its pieces location.

statements.name: NothingRecordedIsKept
statements.says: A recording with no complete piece is kept with an error explaining that nothing was recorded and why.

statements.name: StopSavedBeforeEffect
statements.says: The Stop is saved before the caller is asked to stop capture.

statements.name: StoppedCaptureIsStopping
statements.says: A stopped recording is asked to stop capture as soon as capture has started.

statements.name: RestartBudgetSaved
statements.says: A saved restart request uses one restart slot even if no startup reply arrives, and the saved count never exceeds the limit.

statements.name: CaptureOwnedByRecording
statements.says: Capture and pending start requests belong to the running recording, and a crash leaves no capture running.

statements.name: RunningCanStillCapture
statements.says: A recording with no capture or startup pending stops blocking new Starts as soon as a saved Stop or the restart limit prevents further capture.

statements.name: RefusalIsHarmless
statements.says: A refused Start requests a refusal notice and leaves the running recording and saved finishing queue unchanged.

statements.name: BriefNoticeCorrect
statements.says: A gap notice follows a successful restart into the same recording, and an automatic Stop notice gives its reason.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every saved record, caller request, outcome, notice, and proof history has its declared type.

statements.name: HandedOver
statements.says: A recording can end handed over as a joined file.

statements.name: PlayablePiecesHandedOver
statements.says: A recording can end handed over as playable pieces with a joining error to show.

statements.name: KeptWithError
statements.says: A recording can be kept with its handover error and pieces location shown.

statements.name: EmptyRecordingExplained
statements.says: A recording with nothing recorded can end with that fact and its reason shown.

statements.name: StartsDuringFinishing
statements.says: A new recording can start while an earlier recording is still being finished.

statements.name: RefusedWhileRunning
statements.says: A second Start can be refused while a recording is running.

statements.name: StoppedDuringStartup
statements.says: A Stop can be saved while capture is still starting.

statements.name: GapResumed
statements.says: Capture can resume in the same recording and request a gap notice.

statements.name: LimitReached
statements.says: A recording can reach its restart limit and proceed to finishing.

statements.name: UnshownEndSurvivesCrash
statements.says: An end that has not yet been shown can survive a crash in the saved record.

statements.name: InterruptedHandoverShown
statements.says: A recording can be handed over and its end shown after the caller could not restart capture.

statements.name: StoppedEventuallyEnds
statements.says: If On Air eventually stays running and its caller answers each step, every stopped recording or recording whose capture ended for good eventually ends.

statements.name: EveryEndEventuallyShown
statements.says: If On Air eventually stays running and its caller answers each step, every recording's end is eventually shown.

statements.name: ShownEventuallyRemoved
statements.says: If On Air eventually stays running and its caller answers each step, each recording whose end was shown is eventually removed from the saved record.

statements.name: GapEventuallyResolved
statements.says: If On Air eventually stays running, every gap eventually leads to a restart request or finishing.

statements.name: AcceptWhileBusy
statements.says: A faulty session accepts another Start while a recording is already running.

statements.name: ForgetBeforeMenuSaysEnd
statements.says: A faulty session removes an ended recording before the menu actually says its end.

statements.name: RestartDespiteStop
statements.says: A faulty session restarts capture after a Stop was saved.

statements.name: IgnoreStopDuringStartup
statements.says: A faulty session receives a Stop during startup but fails to save it.

statements.name: UnconfirmedRestartSurvives
statements.says: On Air can die with a restart request saved and no startup reply received.

statements.name: FairSessionProgress
statements.says: Each recording's next internal step eventually runs whenever an internal step remains possible.

model.module_text:
---- MODULE RecordingSession ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Recordings, MaxRestarts, AutomaticReasons, FailureReasons
VARIABLES up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends,
    finishPending, finishAsked, stopAsked, requested, confirmed, startAsked,
    shown, notice, announced, outcome, message, messageId, messageReason, refusal, stopReceived

vars == <<up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends,
    finishPending, finishAsked, stopAsked, requested, confirmed, startAsked,
    shown, notice, announced, outcome, message, messageId, messageReason, refusal, stopReceived>>

\* Candidate A of F1; this expression selects when an uncertain restart consumes its allowance.
CountOnRequest == TRUE

Phases == {"new", "starting", "live", "stopping", "gap", "queued", "finishing", "ended", "gone"}
Results == {"handed", "fallback", "kept", "empty"}
StopReasons == {"person"} \cup AutomaticReasons
Causes == {"none", "start-failed", "resume-failed", "limit"}
RecordType == [phase : Phases, stop : BOOLEAN, tries : 0..MaxRestarts, restarting : BOOLEAN, cause : Causes, failure : FailureReasons \cup {"none"}, result : Results \cup {"none"}]
InitialRecord == [phase |-> "new", stop |-> FALSE, tries |-> 0, restarting |-> FALSE, cause |-> "none", failure |-> "none", result |-> "none"]
NoticeType == [result : {"none", "handed", "kept"}, error : {"none", "join-failed", "handover-failed", "nothing-recorded"}, reason : Causes \cup FailureReasons \cup {"stopped"}, location : Recordings \cup {"none"}]
NoNotice == [result |-> "none", error |-> "none", reason |-> "none", location |-> "none"]
Running == {r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase \in {"starting", "live", "stopping", "gap"}}
Stored == {r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase \notin {"new", "gone"}}
Stopped == {r \in Recordings : rec[r].stop}
Final == {finalOrder[i] : i \in 1..Len(finalOrder)}
Ended == {ends[i][1] : i \in 1..Len(ends)}
Queue == SubSeq(finalOrder, Len(ends) + 1, Len(finalOrder))
Saved == <<rec, Queue, outcome>>
Handed(r) == rec[r].result \in {"handed", "fallback"}
FinishError(result) ==
    CASE result = "handed" -> "none"
      [] result = "fallback" -> "join-failed"
      [] result = "kept" -> "handover-failed"
      [] OTHER -> "nothing-recorded"

EndNotice(r, result, includeReason) ==
    [result |-> IF result \in {"handed", "fallback"} THEN "handed" ELSE "kept",
     error |-> FinishError(result),
     reason |-> IF result = "empty"
                  THEN IF rec[r].failure # "none" THEN rec[r].failure
                       ELSE IF rec[r].cause # "none" THEN rec[r].cause ELSE IF rec[r].stop THEN "stopped" ELSE "none"
                  ELSE IF includeReason /\ result \in {"handed", "fallback"} /\ rec[r].cause = "resume-failed"
                       THEN rec[r].failure ELSE "none",
     location |-> IF result \in {"handed", "fallback"} THEN "none" ELSE r]

\* r also stands for the caller's immutable selection and pieces location.
\* There are no file operations here; pieces is the caller's durable fact
\* that at least one complete piece exists. Errors are representative values.
\* accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishAsked, requested, confirmed,
\* stopReceived, shown and announced are proof bookkeeping, not retained files.
\* Capture metadata and its bookkeeping are discarded when the outcome is saved;
\* only outcome and notification progress matter after that recording ends.
\* rec entries at new/gone are absent from the real saved record; their
\* remaining fields are proof history. Queue is the saved pending FIFO.
\* An outcome at gone is likewise only a proof receipt, outside Stored.
\* pending, active, finishPending, startAsked, stopAsked, notice and message are volatile caller work.
\* A piece may be written after a start takes effect but before its reply.
\* StopAsked is the current stop-command output, not a retained history.
\* A person Stop also represents Quit and stopping through macOS controls.
\* Every command-producing transition commits its record before its caller
\* can execute the command. Candidate A charges a slot in that commit;
\* candidate B charges only the successful startup reply. The requested
\* history saturates at MaxRestarts + 1 solely to keep the proof finite;
\* it distinguishes within-limit requests from arbitrarily many uncertain ones.
\* Additional context in a successful handover notice is left unspecified.
\* A brief message is an output delivered once by the caller, and can be
\* lost on a crash; only end messages have a saved acknowledgement protocol.

TypeOK ==
    /\ up \in BOOLEAN
    /\ rec \in [Recordings -> RecordType]
    /\ active \subseteq Recordings
    /\ pending \subseteq Recordings
    /\ pieces \subseteq Recordings
    /\ accepted \subseteq Recordings
    /\ finalOrder \in Seq(Recordings)
    /\ ends \in Seq(Recordings \X Results)
    /\ finishPending \subseteq Recordings
    /\ finishAsked \subseteq Recordings
    /\ stopAsked \subseteq Recordings
    /\ requested \in [Recordings -> 0..(MaxRestarts + 1)]
    /\ confirmed \in [Recordings -> 0..MaxRestarts]
    /\ startAsked \subseteq Recordings
    /\ shown \subseteq Recordings
    /\ notice \in [Recordings -> {"none", "asked", "shown"}]
    /\ announced \in [Recordings -> NoticeType]
    /\ outcome \in [Recordings -> NoticeType]
    /\ message \in {"none", "refused", "gap", "automatic"}
    /\ messageId \in Recordings \cup {"none"}
    /\ messageReason \in StopReasons \cup {"none"}
    /\ stopReceived \subseteq Recordings
    /\ (refusal = <<>> \/
          /\ Len(refusal) = 3
          /\ refusal[1] \in [Recordings -> RecordType]
          /\ refusal[2] \in Seq(Recordings)
          /\ refusal[3] \in [Recordings -> NoticeType])

OneRecording == Cardinality(Running) <= 1

RecordingRetained ==
    /\ accepted \ {r \in shown : r \in Ended} \subseteq Stored
    /\ Stored \subseteq accepted
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "gone" => r \in Ended \cap shown

StopRemembered == stopReceived = Stopped

NoRestartAfterStop == startAsked \cap (stopReceived \cup Ended) = {}

FinishAfterCapture ==
    /\ finishAsked \subseteq Final
    /\ Final \cap (Running \cup active \cup pending) = {}

FinishInOrder ==
    /\ Cardinality(finishPending) <= 1
    /\ Len(ends) <= Len(finalOrder)
    /\ \A i \in 1..Len(ends) : ends[i][1] = finalOrder[i]
    /\ \A r \in finishPending : Queue # <<>> /\ r = Head(Queue)
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "finishing" => Queue # <<>> /\ r = Head(Queue)

ExactlyOneEnd ==
    /\ Cardinality(Final) = Len(finalOrder)
    /\ Cardinality(Ended) = Len(ends)
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : (r \in Ended) <=> (rec[r].result \in Results)
    /\ \A i \in 1..Len(ends) : rec[ends[i][1]].result = ends[i][2]
    /\ \A r \in Ended : rec[r].phase \in {"ended", "gone"}

EndShownCorrectly ==
    /\ shown \subseteq Ended
    /\ \A r \in shown : announced[r] = outcome[r]
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : notice[r] = "shown" => r \in shown

NothingRecordedIsKept ==
    /\ \A r \in Ended : (r \notin pieces) <=> (rec[r].result = "empty")
    /\ \A r \in Ended : rec[r].result = "empty" => outcome[r].reason # "none"

OutcomeMatchesFinish ==
    \A r \in Ended :
        /\ outcome[r].result = (IF Handed(r) THEN "handed" ELSE "kept")
        /\ outcome[r].error = FinishError(rec[r].result)
        /\ outcome[r].location = (IF Handed(r) THEN "none" ELSE r)

StopSavedBeforeEffect == stopAsked \subseteq Stopped

StoppedCaptureIsStopping == active \cap Stopped \subseteq {r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "stopping"}

RestartBudgetSaved ==
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].tries = (IF CountOnRequest THEN requested[r] ELSE confirmed[r]) /\ rec[r].tries <= MaxRestarts
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : confirmed[r] <= requested[r]
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].cause = "limit" => rec[r].tries = MaxRestarts

CaptureOwnedByRecording ==
    /\ active \cup pending \subseteq Running
    /\ startAsked \subseteq pending
    /\ active \cap pending = {}
    /\ \A r \in pending : rec[r].phase = "starting"
    /\ \A r \in active : rec[r].phase \in {"live", "stopping"}
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "stopping" => r \in Stopped
    /\ ~up => active = {} /\ pending = {} /\ finishPending = {}

RunningCanStillCapture ==
    up => \A r \in Running \ (active \cup pending) : ~rec[r].stop /\ rec[r].tries < MaxRestarts

RefusalIsHarmless ==
    message = "refused" => Running # {} /\ refusal = Saved /\ messageId \notin accepted

BriefNoticeCorrect ==
    /\ (message = "gap" => messageId \in active /\ rec[messageId].tries > 0)
    /\ (message = "automatic" => messageId \in Stopped /\ messageReason \in AutomaticReasons)

HandedOver == \E r \in Ended : rec[r].result = "handed"
PlayablePiecesHandedOver == \E r \in Ended : rec[r].result = "fallback"
KeptWithError == \E r \in shown : rec[r].result = "kept"
EmptyRecordingExplained == \E r \in shown : rec[r].result = "empty"
StartsDuringFinishing == Running # {} /\ finishPending # {}
RefusedWhileRunning == message = "refused"
StoppedDuringStartup == Stopped \cap pending # {}
GapResumed == message = "gap"
LimitReached == \E r \in Final : rec[r].cause = "limit"
UnshownEndSurvivesCrash == ~up /\ (Ended \ shown) \cap Stored # {}
InterruptedHandoverShown == \E r \in shown : rec[r].result = "handed" /\ outcome[r].reason \in FailureReasons

\* These are explicit environmental hypotheses, not fairness imposed on
\* people or the caller. Crashes may happen forever, and no Stop is assumed.
CallerAnswers ==
    \A r \in Recordings :
        /\ []<>(~up \/ r \notin pending)
        /\ []<>(~up \/ r \notin active \/ rec[r].phase # "stopping")
        /\ []<>(~up \/ r \notin finishPending)
        /\ []<>(~up \/ notice[r] # "asked")

StoppedEventuallyEnds ==
    (<>[]up /\ CallerAnswers) => (\A r \in Recordings : (r \in Stopped \cup Final) ~> (r \in Ended))

EveryEndEventuallyShown ==
    (<>[]up /\ CallerAnswers) => (\A r \in Recordings : (r \in Ended) ~> (r \in shown))

ShownEventuallyRemoved ==
    (<>[]up /\ CallerAnswers) => (\A r \in Recordings : (r \in shown) ~> (rec[r].phase = "gone"))

GapEventuallyResolved ==
    (<>[]up) => (\A r \in Recordings : (rec[r].phase = "gap") ~> (rec[r].phase = "starting" \/ r \in Final))

Init ==
    /\ up = TRUE
    /\ rec = [r \in Recordings |-> InitialRecord]
    /\ active = {} /\ pending = {} /\ pieces = {} /\ accepted = {}
    /\ finalOrder = <<>> /\ ends = <<>>
    /\ requested = [r \in Recordings |-> 0]
    /\ confirmed = [r \in Recordings |-> 0]
    /\ startAsked = {}
    /\ finishPending = {} /\ finishAsked = {} /\ stopAsked = {}
    /\ shown = {} /\ stopReceived = {}
    /\ notice = [r \in Recordings |-> "none"]
    /\ announced = [r \in Recordings |-> NoNotice]
    /\ outcome = [r \in Recordings |-> NoNotice]
    /\ message = "none" /\ messageId = "none" /\ messageReason = "none" /\ refusal = <<>>

Start(r) ==
    /\ up /\ r \notin accepted /\ Running = {}
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "starting"]
    /\ accepted' = accepted \cup {r}
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {r}
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pieces, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {r}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

RefuseStart(r) ==
    /\ up /\ r \notin accepted /\ Running # {}
    /\ message' = "refused" /\ messageId' = r /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = Saved
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

Stop(r, why) ==
    /\ up /\ r \in Running /\ r \notin Stopped
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].stop = TRUE, ![r].phase = IF r \in active THEN "stopping" ELSE IF r \in pending THEN @ ELSE "queued"]
    /\ finalOrder' = IF r \in active \cup pending THEN finalOrder ELSE Append(finalOrder, r)
    /\ stopReceived' = stopReceived \cup {r}
    /\ stopAsked' = IF r \in active THEN {r} ELSE {}
    /\ message' = IF why \in AutomaticReasons THEN "automatic" ELSE "none"
    /\ messageId' = IF why \in AutomaticReasons THEN r ELSE "none"
    /\ messageReason' = IF why \in AutomaticReasons THEN why ELSE "none"
    /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pending, pieces, accepted, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}

IgnoreStop(r) ==
    /\ up /\ (r \notin Running \/ r \in Stopped)
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

CaptureStarted(r) ==
    /\ up /\ r \in pending
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = IF r \in Stopped THEN "stopping" ELSE "live", ![r].tries = IF ~CountOnRequest /\ rec[r].restarting THEN @ + 1 ELSE @]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {r} /\ active' = active \cup {r}
    /\ message' = IF rec[r].restarting THEN "gap" ELSE "none"
    /\ messageId' = IF rec[r].restarting THEN r ELSE "none"
    /\ confirmed' = [confirmed EXCEPT ![r] = IF rec[r].restarting THEN @ + 1 ELSE @]
    /\ stopAsked' = IF r \in Stopped THEN {r} ELSE {}
    /\ messageReason' = "none"
    /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}

CaptureStartFailed(r, why) ==
    /\ up /\ r \in pending
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "queued", ![r].cause = IF rec[r].restarting THEN "resume-failed" ELSE "start-failed", ![r].failure = why]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {r} /\ finalOrder' = Append(finalOrder, r)
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pieces, accepted, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

WholePiece(r) ==
    /\ up /\ r \in active \cup pending /\ r \notin pieces
    /\ pieces' = pieces \cup {r}
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, rec, active, pending, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

CaptureEnded(r) ==
    /\ up /\ r \in active
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = IF r \in Stopped \/ rec[r].tries = MaxRestarts THEN "queued" ELSE "gap", ![r].cause = IF r \notin Stopped /\ rec[r].tries = MaxRestarts THEN "limit" ELSE @]
    /\ active' = active \ {r}
    /\ finalOrder' = IF r \in Stopped \/ rec[r].tries = MaxRestarts THEN Append(finalOrder, r) ELSE finalOrder
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, pending, pieces, accepted, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

ContinueGap(r) ==
    /\ up /\ rec[r].phase = "gap"
    /\ IF r \in Stopped \/ rec[r].tries = MaxRestarts
          THEN /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "queued", ![r].cause = IF r \in Stopped THEN @ ELSE "limit"]
               /\ finalOrder' = Append(finalOrder, r)
               /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, requested, outcome>>
               /\ startAsked' = {}
          ELSE /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "starting", ![r].tries = IF CountOnRequest THEN @ + 1 ELSE @, ![r].restarting = TRUE]
               /\ pending' = pending \cup {r}
               /\ requested' = [requested EXCEPT ![r] = IF @ <= MaxRestarts THEN @ + 1 ELSE @]
               /\ startAsked' = {r}
               /\ UNCHANGED finalOrder
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pieces, accepted, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

AskFinish(r) ==
    /\ up /\ Queue # <<>> /\ r = Head(Queue)
    /\ rec[r].phase \in {"queued", "finishing"} /\ finishPending = {}
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "finishing"]
    /\ finishPending' = {r} /\ finishAsked' = finishAsked \cup {r}
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

FinishAnswered(r, result, includeReason) ==
    /\ up /\ r \in finishPending
    /\ result \in IF r \in pieces THEN {"handed", "fallback", "kept"} ELSE {"empty"}
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r] = [InitialRecord EXCEPT !.phase = "ended", !.result = result]]
    /\ outcome' = [outcome EXCEPT ![r] = EndNotice(r, result, includeReason)]
    /\ requested' = [requested EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ confirmed' = [confirmed EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ stopReceived' = stopReceived \ {r}
    /\ ends' = Append(ends, <<r, result>>) /\ finishPending' = {}
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, finishAsked, shown, notice, announced>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

AskEndNotice(r) ==
    /\ up /\ rec[r].phase = "ended" /\ notice[r] = "none"
    /\ notice' = [notice EXCEPT ![r] = "asked"]
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

MenuSaidEnd(r) ==
    /\ up /\ notice[r] = "asked"
    /\ notice' = [notice EXCEPT ![r] = "shown"]
    /\ shown' = shown \cup {r} /\ announced' = [announced EXCEPT ![r] = outcome[r]]
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

AcceptNoticeAck(r) ==
    /\ up /\ rec[r].phase = "ended" /\ notice[r] = "shown"
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "gone"]
    /\ notice' = [notice EXCEPT ![r] = "none"]
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

Crash ==
    /\ up /\ up' = FALSE
    /\ active' = {} /\ pending' = {} /\ finishPending' = {}
    /\ notice' = [r \in Recordings |-> "none"]
    /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
    /\ startAsked' = {}
    /\ stopAsked' = {}

Launch ==
    /\ ~up /\ up' = TRUE
    /\ LET endedCapture == {r \in Running : rec[r].stop \/ rec[r].tries = MaxRestarts}
        IN /\ rec' = [r \in Recordings |->
                          IF r \in Running
                          THEN [rec[r] EXCEPT !.phase = IF r \in endedCapture THEN "queued" ELSE "gap",
                                              !.cause = IF r \in endedCapture /\ ~rec[r].stop THEN "limit" ELSE @]
                          ELSE rec[r]]
           /\ finalOrder' = IF endedCapture = {} THEN finalOrder
                             ELSE Append(finalOrder, CHOOSE r \in endedCapture : TRUE)
    /\ startAsked' = {} /\ stopAsked' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, pending, pieces, accepted, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed,
                    shown, notice, announced, outcome, message, messageId, messageReason, refusal, stopReceived>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

SessionProgress(r) ==
    ContinueGap(r) \/ AskFinish(r) \/ AskEndNotice(r) \/ AcceptNoticeAck(r)

FairSessionProgress == \A r \in Recordings : WF_vars(SessionProgress(r))

Next ==
    \/ Crash \/ Launch \/ Idle
    \/ \E r \in Recordings :
        \/ Start(r) \/ RefuseStart(r) \/ IgnoreStop(r)
        \/ (\E why \in StopReasons : Stop(r, why))
        \/ CaptureStarted(r) \/ (\E why \in FailureReasons : CaptureStartFailed(r, why)) \/ WholePiece(r)
        \/ CaptureEnded(r) \/ SessionProgress(r)
        \/ (\E result \in Results, b \in BOOLEAN : FinishAnswered(r, result, b))
        \/ MenuSaidEnd(r)

AcceptWhileBusy ==
    \E r \in Recordings :
        /\ up /\ r \notin accepted /\ Running # {}
        /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "starting"]
        /\ accepted' = accepted \cup {r} /\ pending' = pending \cup {r}
        /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pieces, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
        /\ startAsked' = {r}
        /\ stopAsked' = {}

ForgetBeforeMenuSaysEnd ==
    \E r \in Recordings :
        /\ up /\ rec[r].phase = "ended" /\ r \notin shown
        /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "gone"]
        /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
        /\ startAsked' = {}
        /\ stopAsked' = {}

RestartDespiteStop ==
    \E r \in Recordings :
        /\ up /\ Running = {} /\ rec[r].phase = "queued" /\ r \in Stopped /\ rec[r].tries < MaxRestarts
        /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![r].phase = "starting", ![r].tries = IF CountOnRequest THEN @ + 1 ELSE @, ![r].restarting = TRUE]
        /\ pending' = pending \cup {r} /\ requested' = [requested EXCEPT ![r] = IF @ <= MaxRestarts THEN @ + 1 ELSE @]
        /\ startAsked' = {r}
        /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<up, active, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, stopReceived, outcome>>
        /\ stopAsked' = {}

IgnoreStopDuringStartup ==
    \E r \in Recordings :
        /\ up /\ r \in pending /\ r \notin Stopped
        /\ stopReceived' = stopReceived \cup {r}
        /\ message' = "none" /\ messageId' = "none" /\ messageReason' = "none" /\ refusal' = <<>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishPending, finishAsked, requested, confirmed, shown, notice, announced, outcome>>
        /\ startAsked' = {}
        /\ stopAsked' = {}

UnconfirmedRestartSurvives ==
    ~up /\ (\E r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "starting" /\ rec[r].restarting /\ rec[r].tries = (IF CountOnRequest THEN 1 ELSE 0))

model.module_text:
---- MODULE RecordingSession ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Recordings, MaxRestarts, AutomaticReasons, FailureReasons
VARIABLES up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends,
    finishPending, finishAsked, stopAsked, requested, confirmed, startAsked,
    shown, notice, announced, outcome, message, messageId, messageReason, refusal, stopReceived

vars == <<up, rec, active, pending, pieces, accepted, finalOrder, ends,
    finishPending, finishAsked, stopAsked, requested, confirmed, startAsked,
    shown, notice, announced, outcome, message, messageId, messageReason, refusal, stopReceived>>

\* Candidate B of F1; this expression selects when an uncertain restart consumes its allowance.
CountOnRequest == FALSE

Phases == {"new", "starting", "live", "stopping", "gap", "queued", "finishing", "ended", "gone"}
Results == {"handed", "fallback", "kept", "empty"}
StopReasons == {"person"} \cup AutomaticReasons
Causes == {"none", "start-failed", "resume-failed", "limit"}
RecordType == [phase : Phases, stop : BOOLEAN, tries : 0..MaxRestarts, restarting : BOOLEAN, cause : Causes, failure : FailureReasons \cup {"none"}, result : Results \cup {"none"}]
InitialRecord == [phase |-> "new", stop |-> FALSE, tries |-> 0, restarting |-> FALSE, cause |-> "none", failure |-> "none", result |-> "none"]
NoticeType == [result : {"none", "handed", "kept"}, error : {"none", "join-failed", "handover-failed", "nothing-recorded"}, reason : Causes \cup FailureReasons \cup {"stopped"}, location : Recordings \cup {"none"}]
NoNotice == [result |-> "none", error |-> "none", reason |-> "none", location |-> "none"]
Running == {r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase \in {"starting", "live", "stopping", "gap"}}
Stored == {r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase \notin {"new", "gone"}}
Stopped == {r \in Recordings : rec[r].stop}
Final == {finalOrder[i] : i \in 1..Len(finalOrder)}
Ended == {ends[i][1] : i \in 1..Len(ends)}
Queue == SubSeq(finalOrder, Len(ends) + 1, Len(finalOrder))
Saved == <<rec, Queue, outcome>>
Handed(r) == rec[r].result \in {"handed", "fallback"}
FinishError(result) ==
    CASE result = "handed" -> "none"
      [] result = "fallback" -> "join-failed"
      [] result = "kept" -> "handover-failed"
      [] OTHER -> "nothing-recorded"

EndNotice(r, result, includeReason) ==
    [result |-> IF result \in {"handed", "fallback"} THEN "handed" ELSE "kept",
     error |-> FinishError(result),
     reason |-> IF result = "empty"
                  THEN IF rec[r].failure # "none" THEN rec[r].failure
                       ELSE IF rec[r].cause # "none" THEN rec[r].cause ELSE IF rec[r].stop THEN "stopped" ELSE "none"
                  ELSE IF includeReason /\ result \in {"handed", "fallback"} /\ rec[r].cause = "resume-failed"
                       THEN rec[r].failure ELSE "none",
     location |-> IF result \in {"handed", "fallback"} THEN "none" ELSE r]

\* r also stands for the caller's immutable selection and pieces location.
\* There are no file operations here; pieces is the caller's durable fact
\* that at least one complete piece exists. Errors are representative values.
\* accepted, finalOrder, ends, finishAsked, requested, confirmed,
\* stopReceived, shown and announced are proof bookkeeping, not retained files.
\* Capture metadata and its bookkeeping are discarded when the outcome is saved;
\* only outcome and notification progress matter after that recording ends.
\* rec entries at new/gone are absent from the real saved record; their
\* remaining fields are proof history. Queue is the saved pending FIFO.
\* An outcome at gone is likewise only a proof receipt, outside Stored.
\* pending, active, finishPending, startAsked, stopAsked, notice and message are volatile caller work.
\* A piece may be written after a start takes effect but before its reply.
\* StopAsked is the current stop-command output, not a retained history.
\* A person Stop also represents Quit and stopping through macOS controls.
\* Every command-producing transition commits its record before its caller
\* can execute the command. Candidate A charges a slot in that commit;
\* candidate B charges only the successful startup reply. The requested
\* history saturates at MaxRestarts + 1 solely to keep the proof finite;
\* it distinguishes within-limit requests from arbitrarily many uncertain ones.
\* Additional context in a successful handover notice is left unspecified.
\* A brief message is an output delivered once by the caller, and can be
\* lost on a crash; only end messages have a saved acknowledgement protocol.

TypeOK ==
    /\ up \in BOOLEAN
    /\ rec \in [Recordings -> RecordType]
    /\ active \subseteq Recordings
    /\ pending \subseteq Recordings
    /\ pieces \subseteq Recordings
    /\ accepted \subseteq Recordings
    /\ finalOrder \in Seq(Recordings)
    /\ ends \in Seq(Recordings \X Results)
    /\ finishPending \subseteq Recordings
    /\ finishAsked \subseteq Recordings
    /\ stopAsked \subseteq Recordings
    /\ requested \in [Recordings -> 0..(MaxRestarts + 1)]
    /\ confirmed \in [Recordings -> 0..MaxRestarts]
    /\ startAsked \subseteq Recordings
    /\ shown \subseteq Recordings
    /\ notice \in [Recordings -> {"none", "asked", "shown"}]
    /\ announced \in [Recordings -> NoticeType]
    /\ outcome \in [Recordings -> NoticeType]
    /\ message \in {"none", "refused", "gap", "automatic"}
    /\ messageId \in Recordings \cup {"none"}
    /\ messageReason \in StopReasons \cup {"none"}
    /\ stopReceived \subseteq Recordings
    /\ (refusal = <<>> \/
          /\ Len(refusal) = 3
          /\ refusal[1] \in [Recordings -> RecordType]
          /\ refusal[2] \in Seq(Recordings)
          /\ refusal[3] \in [Recordings -> NoticeType])

OneRecording == Cardinality(Running) <= 1

RecordingRetained ==
    /\ accepted \ {r \in shown : r \in Ended} \subseteq Stored
    /\ Stored \subseteq accepted
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "gone" => r \in Ended \cap shown

StopRemembered == stopReceived = Stopped

NoRestartAfterStop == startAsked \cap (stopReceived \cup Ended) = {}

FinishAfterCapture ==
    /\ finishAsked \subseteq Final
    /\ Final \cap (Running \cup active \cup pending) = {}

FinishInOrder ==
    /\ Cardinality(finishPending) <= 1
    /\ Len(ends) <= Len(finalOrder)
    /\ \A i \in 1..Len(ends) : ends[i][1] = finalOrder[i]
    /\ \A r \in finishPending : Queue # <<>> /\ r = Head(Queue)
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "finishing" => Queue # <<>> /\ r = Head(Queue)

ExactlyOneEnd ==
    /\ Cardinality(Final) = Len(finalOrder)
    /\ Cardinality(Ended) = Len(ends)
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : (r \in Ended) <=> (rec[r].result \in Results)
    /\ \A i \in 1..Len(ends) : rec[ends[i][1]].result = ends[i][2]
    /\ \A r \in Ended : rec[r].phase \in {"ended", "gone"}

EndShownCorrectly ==
    /\ shown \subseteq Ended
    /\ \A r \in shown : announced[r] = outcome[r]
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : notice[r] = "shown" => r \in shown

NothingRecordedIsKept ==
    /\ \A r \in Ended : (r \notin pieces) <=> (rec[r].result = "empty")
    /\ \A r \in Ended : rec[r].result = "empty" => outcome[r].reason # "none"

OutcomeMatchesFinish ==
    \A r \in Ended :
        /\ outcome[r].result = (IF Handed(r) THEN "handed" ELSE "kept")
        /\ outcome[r].error = FinishError(rec[r].result)
        /\ outcome[r].location = (IF Handed(r) THEN "none" ELSE r)

StopSavedBeforeEffect == stopAsked \subseteq Stopped

StoppedCaptureIsStopping == active \cap Stopped \subseteq {r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "stopping"}

RestartBudgetSaved ==
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].tries = (IF CountOnRequest THEN requested[r] ELSE confirmed[r]) /\ rec[r].tries <= MaxRestarts
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : confirmed[r] <= requested[r]
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].cause = "limit" => rec[r].tries = MaxRestarts

CaptureOwnedByRecording ==
    /\ active \cup pending \subseteq Running
    /\ startAsked \subseteq pending
    /\ active \cap pending = {}
    /\ \A r \in pending : rec[r].phase = "starting"
    /\ \A r \in active : rec[r].phase \in {"live", "stopping"}
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : rec[r].phase = "stopping" => r \in Stopped
    /\ ~up => active = {} /\ pending = {} /\ finishPending = {}

RunningCanStillCapture ==
    up => \A r \in Running \ (active \cup pending) : ~rec[r].stop /\ rec[r].tries < MaxRestarts

RefusalIsHarmless ==
    message = "refused" => Running # {} /\ refusal = Saved /\ messageId \notin accepted

BriefNoticeCorrect ==
    /\ (message = "gap" => messageId \in active /\ rec[messageId].tries > 0)
    /\ (message = "automatic" => messageId \in Stopped /\ messageReason \in AutomaticReasons)

HandedOver == \E r \in Ended : rec[r].result = "handed"
PlayablePiecesHandedOver == \E r \in Ended : rec[r].result = "fallback"
KeptWithError == \E r \in shown : rec[r].result = "kept"
EmptyRecordingExplained == \E r \in shown : rec[r].result = "empty"
StartsDuringFinishing == Running # {} /\ finishPending # {}
RefusedWhileRunning == message = "refused"
StoppedDuringStartup == Stopped \cap pending # {}
GapResumed == message = "gap"
LimitReached == \E r \in Final : rec[r].cause = "limit"
UnshownEndSurvivesCrash == ~up /\ (Ended \ shown) \cap Stored # {}
InterruptedHandoverShown == \E r \in shown : rec[r].result = "handed" /\ outcome[r].reason \in FailureReasons

\* These are explicit environmental hypotheses, not fairness imposed on
\* people or the caller. Crashes may happen forever, and no Stop is assumed.
CallerAnswers ==
    \A r \in Recordings :
        /\ []<>(~up \/ r \notin pending)
        /\ []<>(~up \/ r \notin active \/ rec[r].phase # "stopping")
        /\ []<>(~up \/ r \notin finishPending)
        /\ []<>(~up \/ notice[r] # "asked")

StoppedEventuallyEnds ==
    (<>[]up /\ CallerAnswers) => (\A r \in Recordings : (r \in Stopped \cup Final) ~> (r \in Ended))

EveryEndEventuallyShown ==
    (<>[]up /\ CallerAnswers) => (\A r \in Recordings : (r \in Ended) ~> (r \in shown))

ShownEventuallyRemoved ==
    (<>[]up /\ CallerAnswers) => (\A r \in Recordings : (r \in shown) ~> (rec[r].phase = "gone"))

GapEventuallyResolved ==
    (<>[]up) => (\A r \in Recordings : (rec[r].phase = "gap") ~> (rec[r].phase = "starting" \/ r \in Final))

Init ==
    /\ up = TRUE
    /\ rec = [r \in Recordings |-> InitialRecord]
    /\ active = {} /\ pending = {} /\ pieces = {} /\ accepted = {}
    /\ finalOrder = <<>> /\ ends = <<>>
    /\ requested = [r \in Recordings |-> 0]
    /\ confirmed = [r \in Recordings |-> 0]
    /\ startAsked = {}
    /\ finishPending = {} /\ finishAsked = {} /\ stopAsked = {}
    /\ shown = {} /\ stopReceived = {}
    /\ notice = [r \in Recordings |-> "none"]
    /\ announced = [r \in Recordings |-> NoNotice]
    /\ outcome = [r \in Recordings |-> NoNotice]
    /\ message = "none" /\ messageId = "none" /\ messageReason = "none" /\ refusal = <<>>

Start(r) ==

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The session starts in its initial state and changes only through the modeled steps.

pins.name: OneRecording
pins.says: At most one recording is running, including while capture is starting, stopping, or waiting to resume.

pins.name: RecordingRetained
pins.says: Every accepted recording remains in the saved record until it has ended and its end has actually been shown.

pins.name: StopRemembered
pins.says: Every Stop received for a running recording is saved until that recording ends, including during startup and across a crash.

pins.name: NoRestartAfterStop
pins.says: Once a Stop is saved, no further request to start capture is made for that recording.

pins.name: FinishAfterCapture
pins.says: Finishing is requested only after capture has ended for good and can no longer write pieces.

pins.name: FinishInOrder
pins.says: Only one recording is being finished at a time, in the order capture ended for good, including after a crash.

pins.name: ExactlyOneEnd
pins.says: Each recording ends at most once, with a single permanent outcome of handed over or kept.

pins.name: OutcomeMatchesFinish
pins.says: The saved end notice contains the outcome and error reported by finishing, and the pieces location when the recording is kept.

pins.name: EndShownCorrectly
pins.says: Every end notice reports its saved outcome and finishing error, and a kept recording's notice includes its pieces location.

pins.name: NothingRecordedIsKept
pins.says: A recording with no complete piece is kept with an error explaining that nothing was recorded and why.

pins.name: StopSavedBeforeEffect
pins.says: The Stop is saved before the caller is asked to stop capture.

pins.name: StoppedCaptureIsStopping
pins.says: A stopped recording is asked to stop capture as soon as capture has started.

pins.name: RestartBudgetSaved
pins.says: Only a successful restart reported by the caller uses a restart slot, and the saved count never exceeds the limit.

pins.name: CaptureOwnedByRecording
pins.says: Capture and pending start requests belong to the running recording, and a crash leaves no capture running.

pins.name: RunningCanStillCapture
pins.says: A recording with no capture or startup pending stops blocking new Starts as soon as a saved Stop or the restart limit prevents further capture.

pins.name: RefusalIsHarmless
pins.says: A refused Start requests a refusal notice and leaves the running recording and saved finishing queue unchanged.

pins.name: BriefNoticeCorrect
pins.says: A gap notice follows a successful restart into the same recording, and an automatic Stop notice gives its reason.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every saved record, caller request, outcome, notice, and proof history has its declared type.

pins.name: HandedOver
pins.says: A recording can end handed over as a joined file.

pins.name: PlayablePiecesHandedOver
pins.says: A recording can end handed over as playable pieces with a joining error to show.

pins.name: KeptWithError
pins.says: A recording can be kept with its handover error and pieces location shown.

pins.name: EmptyRecordingExplained
pins.says: A recording with nothing recorded can end with that fact and its reason shown.

pins.name: StartsDuringFinishing
pins.says: A new recording can start while an earlier recording is still being finished.

pins.name: RefusedWhileRunning
pins.says: A second Start can be refused while a recording is running.

pins.name: StoppedDuringStartup
pins.says: A Stop can be saved while capture is still starting.

pins.name: GapResumed
pins.says: Capture can resume in the same recording and request a gap notice.

pins.name: LimitReached
pins.says: A recording can reach its restart limit and proceed to finishing.

pins.name: UnshownEndSurvivesCrash
pins.says: An end that has not yet been shown can survive a crash in the saved record.

pins.name: InterruptedHandoverShown
pins.says: A recording can be handed over and its end shown after the caller could not restart capture.

pins.name: StoppedEventuallyEnds
pins.says: If On Air eventually stays running and its caller answers each step, every stopped recording or recording whose capture ended for good eventually ends.

pins.name: EveryEndEventuallyShown
pins.says: If On Air eventually stays running and its caller answers each step, every recording's end is eventually shown.

pins.name: ShownEventuallyRemoved

pins.name: GapEventuallyResolved
